race.comment: HOLY HOLY HOLY (10) is the horse to beat after two strong recent placings, the latest a second in CL1 company at Mt Isa when she chased Champonnet home and was beaten a length and a half. Her prior third at this track reads well for this, and the class drop, low weight and 1.5kg claim give her a very solid platform. ZOUSTRONG (5) is the obvious danger, having won a BM50 at Mt Isa as an odds-on favourite after a luckless second in CL1 grade at Cloncurry. The back to 1300m is a small query, but he has enough current form. OUTBACK STEP (7) comes off a BM50 win at Longreach and gets an important 3kg claim to offset the big weight. In the mix again if he holds his form. FINAL COMMENT (6) was poor in a BM60 last start, but he had excuses after being slow away and wide, and his previous win at this track keeps him in the mix.
